name: the boomerang's +0x4C, each game's sprite update's leftover r2
why: Boomer's boomerang's init (BN4's third-kind 0x32, moved with Boomer's unit) stores r2 at +0x4C (str r2,[r5,#0x4c] at 0x080D32AA) after its sprite's update (bl 0x0800283C at 0x080D3282; BN6's twin 0x080026A4 through the copy's veneer), which nothing between sets: each game's update's leftover there, 0 in BN4's and a pointer into the sprite in BN6's. No code of the object loads its +0x4C: its region (0x080D3234-0x080D3468, walked by tools/xchiprecipe_bn4.py) holds that one store. bn4_chip_boomer3 at t33
